our_interpretation: This describes Marcus’s reported tests, not an assertion that every possible generation must fail.
Improvement means better adherence to some prompts from his original article compared with the earlier outputs.
The woman-and-watch output must jointly depict left-handed writing, a watch on the right wrist, the time 3:20, and the requested inscription.
New means not previously discussed in his published examples; it does not establish absence from training data.
The target is the testing reported by June 25, 2025. The exact testing dates are unspecified, so the start is left unknown.
criteria.support_condition: Authenticated records of the reported tests show improved adherence on some original prompts and failure to satisfy all requirements in the reported woman-and-watch attempt or attempts.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Authenticated records of those same tests show that the alleged failed woman-and-watch output satisfied all requirements, or establish that the claimed improvements on the original examples did not occur. A successful generation in another session cannot contradict the reported failure.
